appended.mechanism_name: Integrate a durable, covalently bonded heparin coating on the internal lumen and external surface of tunneled hemodialys
appended.what_was_proposed: Heparin coating on catheter surfaces provides an anticoagulant layer that inhibits thrombus formation and fibrin deposition, maintaining lumen patency.
